title: In nomine Jesu (Josquin)
desc: Josquin, In nomine Jesu. 6 voices (Cantus I, Cantus II, Altus, Tenor, Vagans, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos1907); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
